title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW' (HCF 2026)

title_lang.zh_hk: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW' (HCF 2026)

synopsis:
Broadway Cinemas exclusively presents HYBE CINE FEST 2026 ! bringing your favorite HYBE’s artists to the big screen! Featureing SEVENTEEN, ENHYPEN, TXT and BTS!  EVERYWHERE, WE CHEER!


Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
百老匯戲院獨家呈獻 HYBE CINE FEST 2026！將你最愛的 HYBE 旗下藝人帶到大銀幕！ 陣容包括 SEVENTEEN、ENHYPEN、TXT 同埋 BTS！EVERYWHERE, WE CHEER! 應援無處不在！

 

如同璀璨繁星，TOMORROW X TOGETHER 第 4 次世界巡迴演唱會《ACT : TOMORROW》華麗展開，踏上彼此約定的明日之旅。從動人的敘事、驚豔的舞台製作，到震撼全球 MOA 的精彩現場演出——在大銀幕上沉浸感受 TOMORROW X TOGETHER 世界巡迴演唱會帶來的極致華麗！
